site: Intracoastal Waterway to Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse
about: The parade is a premier event of the Marine Industries Association of Palm Beach County and is billed as a gift to the community that kicks off the holiday season.
A Zambelli traveling fireworks display leads the boats along the Intracoastal Waterway from North Palm Beach to the Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse.
Boats are judged on lights, enthusiasm and themed decor, with Best of Parade, Fan Favorite and Rookie of the Year awards.
The association lists bridge opening estimates along the route, including the Parker Bridge around 6:00 PM, the PGA Bridge around 6:15 PM and the Donald Ross Bridge around 7:00 PM.
The Indiantown Road Bridge opens around 7:30 PM and the Jupiter Federal Bridge around 7:45 PM, so boats reach the lighthouse near 8 PM.
Public viewing sites on the association's list include Bert Winters Park, Juno Park, Sawfish Bay Park, Lighthouse Park, Waterway Park and the Riverwalk.
The parade doubles as a toy drive for Toys for Tots and Little Smiles of South Florida, with Marines collecting gifts by boat during the parade.
The association also says the parade can be watched live on the WPBF app and the station's Facebook page.
